versions.name: Java build environment (Temurin JDK)
versions.description: Run commands inside a pinned Temurin JDK (21, 25, or 17) with JAVA_HOME exported. Maven users can add -Dmaven.repo.local to share the local repository via the cache.
versions.author: buz maintainers
